# olh'o'posto

> Community photos of EV charging stations and sockets in Portugal, with one stable static photo link per station and per socket, keyed by the official NAP Portugal (MOBI.E) codes.

Pages are in European Portuguese, with English under /en/. Station and socket data come from NAP Portugal (MOBI.E), matched to OpenStreetMap, and are refreshed daily. Photo uploads are open and moderated; stations without an approved photo return 404 on their static link.

## Pages

- [Station page](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/stations/EZC-AMD-00051): `/en/stations/{station id}` in English, `/postos/{station id}` in Portuguese.
- Photo credit page: `/en/p/{photo id}` (or `/p/{photo id}`): the photo, its author, date and licence (CC BY-SA 4.0), the station or socket it shows and a link to Panoramax. Only published photos have one; the XMP of each new static copy points to it, and the station page links each photo to it.
- [Search](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/search?q=amadora): `/en/search?q=` (or `/pesquisa?q=`). A full station or socket code goes straight to its page.
- [Stations without a photo](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/stations/without-photo): `/en/stations/without-photo` (or `/postos/sem-foto`), filterable by municipality and operator; each links to the upload page for that station.
- Socket lookup: `/en/sockets/{EVSE code}` (or `/tomadas/{EVSE code}`) redirects to the station page, anchored on that socket. The code works with or without the `*` (`PT*EZC*E*AMD*00051*1` or `PTEZCEAMD000511`).

## API

JSON, open CORS, no key for reads (the OpenAPI description is at `/api/v1/openapi.json`).

- `GET /api/v1/stations/{station id}`: the station, its operator, address, coordinates, OSM element and sockets. Each socket has its EVSE code as published (`evse`) and without the `*` (`compact`), which is the name of its static link. The station and each socket carry `photo` (or `null`): credit, licence, a ready-to-paste `attribution`, the three sizes (`thumb`, `main`, `full`, each with `url` and `maxPx`, the longest side), the station page and the Panoramax viewer link.
- `GET /api/v1/stations?q={words}&limit={1-50}`: full-text search over station code, name, address, town and operator. Every word must match, as a prefix, accents ignored. Public stations only, best match first.
- `GET /api/v1/stations?lat={deg}&lon={deg}&radius={metres, default 500, max 5000}&limit={1-50}`: public stations near a point, nearest first, each with `distance_m`. Use either `q` or `lat`/`lon`, not both.
- `GET /api/v1/stations?opc={operator id}&municipality={name}&has_photo=true|false`: filters, on their own (a list by id, paged with `after`/`next`) or narrowing a text or place search. `has_photo=false` lists the stations whose static link is still 404: the ones to photograph.
- `GET /api/v1/photos/{photo id}`: one published photo: credit, licence, target (station or socket), station, sizes, Panoramax id, `attribution`.
- `GET /api/v1/photos.json`: every published photo, gallery included (also references to external photos, told apart by `origin`, each with its own licence), for reusers (cached a day; the station's position, never the photo's GPS).
- `GET /api/v1/main-photos`: every published main photo (station or socket) with its credit, the three sizes on pictures.ocarroeletrico.com, the station page and the Panoramax picture id. Licence CC BY-SA 4.0: credit the author.
- `GET /api/v1/evses/{EVSE code}`: the socket and its station, each with `photo` (or `null`) as above. 300 with `candidates` when the NAP lists the same code at more than one station, 404 when unknown.
- `GET /api/v1/ranking?period=month|all`: top contributors (`rank`, `name`, `points`, `photos`, `medal`), month = current month, UTC.
- `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`: the whole API in OpenAPI 3.1.

## Writing with a token

Writes need a personal access token, created by a signed-in person on their account page (`/conta` or `/en/account`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer oop_…`. A token acts as that person, with their role and limits, under the [terms of use](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/terms). Scopes: `photos:write`, `selections:write` (trusted accounts and moderators only).

- `POST /api/v1/photos` (`photos:write`): multipart with three clean JPEGs, already blurred and without any metadata: `full` (longest side ≤ 2048 px), `main` (≤ 1024), `thumb` (≤ 400), all the same picture; and `meta`, JSON: `{"station": "<station id>", "target": "<station id or compact EVSE code>", "taken_at": "2026-11-20T10:15:00Z" | null, "exif_lat": number | null, "exif_lon": number | null, "license": true, "no_people": true}`. The GPS is for moderators only and is never published. 201 `{id, status}`: `pending` until a moderator approves it, `published` for trusted accounts on site. Files with EXIF are refused.
- `POST /api/v1/stations` (`photos:write`): propose a station missing from the NAP, JSON `{"name", "operator", "code"?, "lat", "lon", "note"?}`. 409 `station_nearby` with the stations within 60 m; repeat with `?force=1` if it is another one. 201 `{id, status: "pending_review"}`; its photos wait for a moderator with it.
- `DELETE /api/v1/photos/{photo id}` (`photos:write`): remove a photo: yours, or any if you are a moderator (optional JSON `{"reason", "note"}`). Static copies and cache go; a lost main photo waits for a moderator to choose the next.
- `PUT /api/v1/selections/{target}` (`selections:write`): JSON `{"photo": "<photo id>"}` makes that published photo the main photo of the station or socket.

## Static photo links

- `https://pictures.ocarroeletrico.com/{station id}.jpg` (1024 px), `.thumb.jpg` (400 px), `.full.jpg` (2048 px).
- Sockets use the EVSE code without the `*`: `https://pictures.ocarroeletrico.com/PTEZCEAMD000511.jpg`.
- The link never changes; the photo behind it can. 404 until the station or socket has a main photo.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/sitemap.xml)
- [The group](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/group) (pt-PT: /grupo): the other sites of the same community (prices, live status, the law), with their code.
- [Privacy policy](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/privacy) (pt-PT: /privacidade)
- [Terms of use](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/terms) (pt-PT: /condicoes): what uploaders and API token holders agree to
- [Ask for a photo to be removed](https://olhaoposto.ocarroeletrico.com/en/report) (pt-PT: /report): no account; the photo is hidden at once and a moderator decides within 72 hours. Each API `photo` has a prefilled `report` link.
